data.gender_notes: Tamqrah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Tamqrah is recorded in name-lists as “Divine protection”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tamqrah expresses “Divine protection”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tamqrah total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
